tagline: A working-class European side district on the Golden Horn — local markets, traditional coffee houses, and a strong community feel far from the tourist trail.

items.name: Alibeyköy Kahvehaneleri
items.description: Traditional Turkish coffee houses around the main square — the social hub of the neighbourhood. Very local, very unhurried.

items.name: Semt Pazarı Lokantalari
items.description: Simple, inexpensive lokanta restaurants serving rotating daily menus of home-style Turkish food. Beloved by the local working community.

items.name: Alibeyköy Barajı
items.description: A reservoir and surrounding green area used by locals for walking and picnics. Quiet and rarely crowded on weekdays.

items.name: Alibeyköy Semt Pazarı
items.description: A lively weekly street market selling fresh produce, clothing, and household goods at very local prices.

tips: Alibeyköy is connected by tram (T5) and bus — getting to the city centre takes 30–40 minutes.
Primarily a residential district — better for living affordably than for leisure outings.
The reservoir area is a hidden green retreat used mostly by locals.
Very affordable rents by Istanbul standards — popular with families and long-term residents.
